aggregate: exactly sum weighted matched cases from complete cohort. Balance by condition before aggregation, positive/foil pairs always compose. Neither missing arms, unqualified fixtures, an absent route, or runner error gets 0, a full score, or denominator normalization. Incomplete v2 reports only observed cases unranked with explicit unresolved fields; never changes v1 base.
authority: Independent verifier qualifies symmetric real observer-visible producers, then reviewer approves new frozen v2 ID/share. Set split and predeclare unseen procedural seeds off shared author storage before any results; fixed rehearsal recipes are never relabeled blind.

frozen_v1.rule: publish v1 independently under exact frozen definition; contributes 60% of a future complete v2 score, not cross-version comparable. Reproduce v1 for every v2-ranked contender on the same conditions; do not use historic sealed as a control.

required_receipts: exact same-origin and opening private digest
legitimate paid executor event and selected grounded target
same pinned valid evaluator and sampler
authenticated graph/reopen and digest-bound backups on promotion
safety_policy: Terminate immediately on actor death or runaway injury gate; native documented in-game ability, never terrain injury as opponent strike. Preserve exact failure evidence. Negative controls not post-hoc exclusions.
